name: Why is wall reinforcement necessary when installing bathroom grab bars?

mainEntity.name: Why is wall reinforcement necessary when installing bathroom grab bars?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grab bars must be secured into structural wall framing or solid wood blocking installed behind the drywall to safely support an adult's weight during a slip or fall. Anchoring bars strictly into drywall or tile with hollow-wall fasteners creates a major safety risk, as they can tear free under heavy pressure. During a bathroom remodel, contractors open wall sections to install solid horizontal 2x6 or 2x8 wood blocking directly between the wall studs, ensuring every bar is permanently and securely fastened.
acceptedAnswer.description: Grab bars require solid wood blocking anchored directly into wall studs behind the drywall to ensure they support full body weight without pulling loose.
